steps: Install 0.1.46-dev and perform the three LocalSend receive operations
Collect namespace tree, flat target, logical sources, Provider status and filtered logcat
Map namespace IDs to canonical source roots and verify same-name physical coexistence
Collect corrected shell MediaStore and root DocumentsProvider diagnostic views
Restart both Providers and verify PID rotation, status republication, namespace tree and file hashes
Delete both test1.jpg objects, receive them again through the two logical sources and verify new timestamps and stable Namespace ownership
Attempt caller-scoped query and open as LocalSend UID 10382; Android rejected the shell process before Provider acquisition because it lacked ACCESS_CONTENT_PROVIDERS_EXTERNALLY
Uninstall pathguard_next, reboot and verify zero module, daemon, mount and Provider hook runtime residue while preserving four physical user-data files
Receive collision.txt twice; observe LocalSend rename the second object before Provider create, leaving exact collision not_observed
Create an isolated unknown Namespace fixture, restart LocalSend to refresh a physically deleted backing mount, verify known logical visibility and unknown logical ENOENT, then remove the fixture
expected_result: Shared target root uses distinct static Namespace paths and same-name files coexist without flat target collision
before_actual: 0.1.44-dev used the prior production boundary and did not provide Namespace Projection evidence
after_actual: 0.1.46-dev produced ns_57xfxvj54rskidat5ak4krdeye for Download/localsend-source and ns_vzn4kspwdxed2tgosk2o4z6bpu for Pictures; both test1.jpg files coexisted, both Providers republished healthy state after PID rotation, and delete-recreate returned each new object to the same Namespace. Caller-scoped query/open could not be constructed with the existing app and shell probe: su 10382 content query/read was rejected before Provider acquisition for missing ACCESS_CONTENT_PROVIDERS_EXTERNALLY, so both are unsupported/not_observed on this device setup. After module uninstall and reboot, module/daemon/mount/Provider-hook residue counts were zero while four physical user-data files remained. LocalSend renamed the second collision.txt to collision (1).txt before Provider create, so exact collision is not_observed. An isolated unknown Namespace remained physical and returned ENOENT from the refreshed LocalSend logical mount while a known Namespace file was visible. External deletion of an active physical Namespace by Solid Explorer left the old mount marked //deleted until LocalSend restart; only restart recovery is claimed.
reviewer_conclusion: Current-device supported scope is complete: physical Namespace isolation, forward/mount scope, Provider restart, delete-recreate, uninstall residue and unknown-Namespace mount exclusion passed. Exact collision and caller-scoped Provider Cursor/open are unsupported/not_observed with the existing LocalSend/probe and were skipped. External physical deletion leaves an active mount stale until app restart and is recorded as a production lifecycle boundary. Unsupported strong-identity cases are skipped.
